fix_summary: §2.5/§9 Q25: 'small-KL token use k1, large-KL token use k3' operational rule is backwards — k3's e^Δ term explodes faster than k1 as KL grows; replaced with an empirical-variance-check recommendation, plus 'holds only when the two distributions are close' qualifiers on the k2/k3 variance-vs-k1 claims (§2.3, §2.4.2).
k3_estimator() docstring: gradient sign fixed to (1 - e^Δ)∇logπ_θ under this section's Δ=logπ_ref-logπ_θ convention, with an explicit note that §3.6 uses the opposite sign convention.
§3.6 (P2) row: k2-as-loss is gradient-equivalent to k1-in-reward only for single-step conditional KL, not the full sequence-level KL.
§7.2 GRPO code: added a rollout-staleness caveat for kl_k3 computed with a stale (multi-epoch-reused) rollout batch.
§6.6/§7.5: 'prompt token KL=0 because policy and ref agree on the prompt' corrected to the mask-semantics reason, fixed at both occurrences.
§7.5 checklist item 7: GRPO KL-dominates-loss comparison corrected to compare against the z-score-normalized advantage, not the raw reward mean.

§9 Q23: early-stop threshold corrected KL_stop=0.5·KL_peak ⇒ √KL < d_peak/√2 (was miscalculated as d_peak/2). Note: the sibling '§9 Q23 PPO fit reverted to d^{3/2} third-order term' error found in the ZH edition did NOT apply here — this EN edition's §6.4.2/§9 already used the correct log-form (per the 2026-06-29 fix above), so no change was needed for that item.
§8.4 DPO length bias: mechanism corrected to length linearly amplifying an un-normalized sum of per-token log-ratio terms, not raw log-prob negativity.
§5.3 SimPO: 'no reference model halves training memory' corrected — only the reference's forward-only footprint is saved, not 50% of total training memory.
REFUTED (kept as-is): the k3 unbiasedness derivation (§2.4.2) omitting the π_ref≪π_θ support condition — defensible simplification, standard in the field.
